69.00726,-97.78354: This plaque is to commemorate and honor Henry "Harry" Duncan Spens Goodsir LRCSE born in Anstruther-Easter, Fife, Scotland on 3 November 1819. Harry Goodsir was a medical doctor, marine zoologist and Assistant Surgeon on HMS Erebus and died here during the Franklin Expedition c. 1847. "Part of all noble things that shall be done. Part of the royal record of the sea." from "The Death of Sir John Franklin" by Algernon C. Swinburne, 1860.
